data.title: How To Buy
data.html:
অর্ডার করার নিয়ম

  1. আপনার পছন্দের পণ্যটিতে ক্লিক করুন।
  2. Add to cart ক্লিক করুন। তারপর উপরের কার্ট আইকনে গিয়ে Proceed to checkout ক্লিক করুন।
  3. আপনার নাম, মোবাইল নম্বর ও পূর্ণ ঠিকানা লিখুন। ডেলিভারি এলাকা ও পেমেন্ট পদ্ধতি বেছে নিন।
  4. Place order ক্লিক করুন।

দ্রুত অর্ডার করতে চাইলে পণ্যের পাতায় Buy now ক্লিক করুন। অর্ডার করতে কোনো অ্যাকাউন্ট লাগে না।

পেমেন্ট

  • Cash on delivery: পণ্য হাতে পেয়ে টাকা দিন।
  • বিকাশ, নগদ বা রকেট: Checkout পাতায় দেখানো নম্বরে টাকা পাঠান, তারপর Place order ক্লিক করার আগে Transaction ID লিখুন।

ডেলিভারি এলাকা: সারা বাংলাদেশ। সাহায্য লাগলে কল করুন {phone}। ধন্যবাদ।

In English

  1. Open the product you want and click Add to cart, or Buy now to go straight to checkout.
  2. From the cart, click Proceed to checkout.
  3. Enter your name, mobile number and full address, then choose your delivery area and payment method.
  4. Click Place order. You do not need an account.

If you pay by bKash, Nagad or Rocket, send the money to the number shown at checkout and enter the transaction ID before you place the order. We deliver all over Bangladesh.

data.title: Terms & Conditions
data.html:
Returns

Our return policy lasts 30 days from your purchase. After 30 days we cannot offer a full refund or exchange.

To be eligible for a return, your item must be unused, in the same condition you received it, and in its original packaging. We need your order number or other proof of purchase.

Please contact us before sending anything back, and please do not send your purchase to the manufacturer.

Items we cannot take back

  • Food and other perishable goods
  • Intimate or sanitary goods
  • Hazardous materials, and flammable liquids or gases
  • Some health and personal care items

Partial refunds

We may give only a partial refund for an item that is not in its original condition, or that is damaged or missing parts for a reason that is not our fault.

Refunds

When we receive your return we will inspect it and tell you whether your refund is approved. If it is, we will send the money back by your original payment method or another method we agree with you.

Sale items

Only regular priced items may be refunded. Sale items cannot be refunded.

Exchanges

We only replace items that are defective or damaged. Contact us and we will tell you how to send the item back.

Return shipping

You are responsible for paying your own shipping costs when you return an item, and shipping costs are non-refundable. If you receive a refund, the cost of return shipping will be deducted from it.

For more expensive items, please use a trackable delivery service. We cannot guarantee that we will receive your returned item.

Need help?

Call {phone} or email {email}.

data.title: Privacy Policy
data.html:
What we collect

When you order, we keep your name, mobile number, delivery address, order details and any note you add. If you pay by mobile payment we also keep the transaction ID. If you create an account we keep your name, mobile number and a protected form of your password, never the password itself. If you contact us we keep your message.

Your cart, wishlist and recent orders are saved in your own browser, on your own device.

How we use it

We use your information to confirm, deliver and support your order, and to protect the shop from fake orders. We share it only where we need to, such as with the courier who brings your order and the services that run this website. We do not sell your personal information.

Your rights

You have the right to ask what personal data we hold about you. To do so, call {phone} or email {email}.

Security

No method of sending data over the Internet or storing it electronically is completely secure. While we cannot guarantee security, we work to protect your information and keep reviewing our measures.

Children

We do not sell products to anyone under 18, and we do not knowingly collect personal data about them. By using this site you confirm that you are at least 18 years old and accept this policy.

data.title: Difference Between Infrared and Induction Cookers
data.excerpt: Infrared and induction cookers look alike but heat your food in different ways. Here is the difference, and which one we suggest.
data.html:
The main difference between infrared and induction cookers is how they make heat.

Infrared cooker

Electric current heats a wire element under the glass. The element glows and gives off infrared heat, which warms the pot.

Induction cooker

Electric current flows through a copper coil and creates a magnetic field. This field produces countless small eddy currents in the base of a steel pot, and those currents make the pot itself hot.

Which should you choose?

Because they work differently, the two cookers use electricity differently. We suggest induction as the best choice for cooking.
